review_method: Recovered all three durable Wan jobs without duplicate submissions; each five-second MP4 passed ffprobe and was reviewed in five one-second contact frames against its specific season cue.

shots.observation: The sunlit scene is attractive and moves, but the yellowing trees and grasses read as autumn rather than unmistakable summer.
shots.use_policy: Do not label this clip as the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice. It may be generic warm-day context only if the final edit needs it and does not contradict adjacent wording.

shots.observation: A coherent snow-covered forest with continuous gentle snowfall clearly reads as winter; no embedded labels are visible.
shots.use_policy: Use once as a winter context cue beside the exact source figure; it does not prove solstice geometry or hemisphere.

shots.observation: A coherent flowering meadow with moving butterflies clearly reads as spring; no embedded labels are visible.
shots.use_policy: Use once as a spring context cue beside the exact source figure; it does not prove equal day/night or a date.
